design.decision: Defend aggressively early in the run, because each set pays for every later round.
design.opponent: Shown on the first set. Its growing value makes opponents more cautious.
design.rationale: Growth gives a common a run-long plan. It also tests whether defence can carry value across rounds.
design.draftText: This sigil gains +3 contract multiplier every time the opponents miss their contract (currently +0)

critic.concerns: Category-only near-duplicate of cb-opp-set-mult; three set-the-opponents commons may crowd the slot.
